_about: Jane-Sixty calibration v0. Every entry is {value, source}. Source tags: service-notes (Juno-60 Service Notes, April 1983, page), owners-manual, schematic (read from the Service Notes drawings), published-measurement (named), simulation (to come), plugin-derived (sanity check only), assumed. See docs/research/05-manual-verified-facts.md.

qCompensation.source: schematic p.9: the stage 1 input (IR3109 pin 2) is a current-summing node (R6 560 to ground, R7 68 k from the stage output), so the mixer enters with gain 68 k / 10 k = 6.8 and the BA662 current with 68 k; compensation leg 47 k with 1.5 k to ground into pin 3 against feedback leg 100 k with 1.5 k into pin 2: (1.5/48.5) / (1.5/101.5) / 6.8 = 0.308. ngspice network run reproduces the passband curve within 0.1 dB (2026-10-06); the demo recording's loudness balance agrees within 2 dB

anchorSliderPos.source: service-notes p.22 Table 6 patch 84, p.24 adj.8-2

trimOffsetOct.source: assumed: unit trim. The factory demo recording sits about 1.2 octaves above the Service Notes trim at every FREQ setting (tools/listen, docs/research/10); 0 restores the manual's calibration

keyFollowPivotNote.source: service-notes p.24 adj.8-3 (C4 = 248 Hz with KYBD 10)

lfoFullDepthOct.source: service-notes p.24 adj.8-7 (40..50 Hz to 4..5 kHz)

passbandLossAtMaxResDb.source: plugin-derived (PicoFaceJ6 vs Roland plugin); replace by simulation

cornerHz.source: schematic p.11 caps 0.022/0.01/0.0047 uF with 47 k (R derived); position 0 flat per owners-manual p.14

sumGainPerVoice.source: schematic p.9: each voice through R50 27 k into the IC23 (TA75558) summer with R369 3.3 k feedback

sumToChorusInput.source: schematic p.9: R370 3.3 k series, R371 10 k to ground, to TP8 / SIG OUT (the chorus board input)

attackSeconds.source: endpoints service-notes p.25 adj.10 (3 s) and spec (1 ms); 2.5/5/7.5 points published-measurement pendragon-andyh scaled 3.25 to 3.0; odd points interpolated (assumed)

decaySeconds.source: endpoints owners-manual p.32 spec (2 ms, 12 s); 2.5/5/7.5 points published-measurement pendragon-andyh scaled 19.8 to 12; odd points interpolated (assumed)

releaseSeconds.source: as decaySeconds (release table measured identical to decay)

timingCapNf.source: assumed: AMSynths IR3R01 note for Juno-6/60, confirm on schematic p.9

rateHz.source: endpoints owners-manual spec 0.3 Hz and service-notes p.23 adj.7-1 (22 Hz); 2.5/5/7.5 published-measurement pendragon-andyh; odd points interpolated (assumed)

delayHoldSeconds.source: service-notes p.24 adj.7-4 (2 s at 10); 2.5/5/7.5 published-measurement pendragon-andyh (2.69 at 10 on that unit, scaled); odd points interpolated (assumed)

bbdStages.source: service-notes p.11, p.26 (MN3009); datasheet: 256 stages, delay 0.64 to 12.8 ms at 200 to 10 kHz clock

bbdSincBandwidth.source: published Holters & Parker DAFx-18 eq. for a constant clock: the BBD output holds each sample for one clock period, a sinc(f / fBBD) roll-off with fBBD = stages / (2 delay); the measured delay sweep (1.66 to 5.35 ms) gives 77 to 24 kHz, the paper quotes a 26 kHz minimum; datasheet Gi-fi: -3 dB near 14 kHz at 40 kHz clock. Modelled as a one-pole tracking 0.443 fBBD (the sinc -3 dB point)

dryGain.source: schematic p.11: IC8 summers, dry through R89 / R88 39 k into 100 k feedback (R95 / R91), normalised to 1

wetGain.source: schematic p.11: wet through R86 / R87 47 k into the same 100 k feedback: 39 / 47 relative to dry

bbdClipVpp.source: service-notes p.25 chorus bias-adjustment test signal: 6 Vp-p 1 kHz sine at TP8 (CPU board, the chorus input) with VCA LEVEL approx. 0 and CHORUS I; bias set so TP1 is not clipped. A test condition, not a measured clipping onset

bbdClipRoomV.source: datasheet MN3009 (Matsushita) THD vs Vi curve: THD sits at 0.4 % up to about 1.4 Vrms, is 2.5 % at 1.5 Vrms (the optimum-bias definition, which the Service Notes 6 Vp-p TP8 test realises) and runs into a wall near 2 Vrms, so the ceiling is about 2.5 dB (1.33x) above the knee: 1.0 V of room above the 3 V peak knee in TP8 volts

noiseDbRe4Vpp.source: datasheet MN3009: S/N 88 dB typ (maximum output voltage, the 1.5 Vrms THD 2.5 % point, to noise), noise 0.2 mVrms max A-weighted at 100 kHz clock. Typical noise 60 uVrms at the BBD; the 1.5 Vrms knee maps to 6 Vp-p (2.12 Vrms) at TP8, so 85 uVrms there, -84.4 dB re a 4 Vp-p sine. The datasheet maximum is 10 dB worse (-74), which the aged-BBD setting offers. White here where the datasheet is A-weighted

preRealHz.source: published Holters & Parker DAFx-18 Table 1 (numerical circuit analysis of the Juno-60 board: real pole 46 580 rad/s) and jpcima's schematic-derived set agree; p.11: R15 10 k + C7 2.2 nF at the BBD input

preAHz.source: published Holters & Parker DAFx-18 Table 1 (pair 55 482 +- 25 082i rad/s) agrees with jpcima's schematic-derived set: 22 k x2, 820 pF / 680 pF Sallen-Key

preBHz.source: published Holters & Parker DAFx-18 Table 1 (pair 26 292 +- 59 437i rad/s) agrees with jpcima's schematic-derived set: 22 k x2, 1.8 nF / 270 pF Sallen-Key

preBQ.source: published Holters & Parker DAFx-18 Table 1 agrees with jpcima's schematic-derived set

postAHz.source: published Holters & Parker DAFx-18 Table 1 (pair 51 468 +- 21 4xxi rad/s) agrees with jpcima's schematic-derived set

postAQ.source: published Holters & Parker DAFx-18 Table 1 agrees with jpcima's schematic-derived set

postBHz.source: published Holters & Parker DAFx-18 Table 1 (pair 26 276 +- 59 4xxi rad/s) agrees with jpcima's schematic-derived set
